text:
QUOTE: "Without a callback and without an allow match, calls are denied" and "In practice, with a callback installed, the only things that stop a call are: deny-list matches"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that an unlisted tool is denied when no callback is set, and that it runs only if a callback exists. It never concludes that default-ALLOW is the effective posture for a tool matching neither list.
